title: ZuCo 1.0: Simultaneous EEG and Eye-Tracking during Natural Reading
description: This dataset (ZuCo 1.0) provides simultaneous 128-channel EEG and eye-tracking recordings from adult native English speakers reading natural sentences. It includes three reading paradigms—sentiment reading, normal reading, and task-specific reading—designed to support research on the neural and oculomotor correlates of natural language comprehension. The resource is intended to facilitate combined EEG and eye-tracking analyses of reading behavior.
methods_description: 128-channel EEG (EGI Geodesic system, 500 Hz sampling, Cz reference) and eye-tracking data (EyeLink 1000, 500 Hz, left eye) were recorded simultaneously while participants read natural sentences across three tasks: sentiment reading, normal reading, and task-specific reading. Eye-tracking gaze and pupil samples were co-located with EEG recordings, and fixations, saccades, and blinks were annotated in events files.
